# Design system

## Badges and pills

A badge is a small, rounded label that carries a status: availability, a count, a tag.
The hero uses a pill with a pulsing dot for availability; numbers use the `NumberBadge`
component. Badges never carry navigation and never replace a heading.

## Accessibility

Every badge has a visible or screen-reader label. Motion respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Headings follow a single `h1` per page, then section headings.

## Colour

Primary tones for interactive elements, zinc for text, one accent per section.
